title: EP-3 May aircraft-return follow-up: source and acquisition register
scope: Bounded follow-up on May flyout permission and May–June removal agreements. No chapters or shared registers edited. Seven newly acquired aircraft-related source texts with mixed full and selected reading; one improved capture/rereading of existing EP311; two indexed-only leads; one auxiliary source read by parent. No scholarly reading count added.

sources.title: 发言人就美方希望EP－3飞机能够从海南岛飞回美国发表谈话
sources.creator: PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.source_type: Contemporary official spokesperson question and answer
sources.reading_scope: Complete short substantive question and answer; navigation excluded.
sources.key_locators: Single question about Rumsfeld’s reported hope for flyout, followed by complete answer; site timestamp 17:05.
sources.interpretation_limits: Public refusal and public claim of previous notification in talks, not an internal instruction or a record of every subsequent exchange.

sources.title: Press Briefing by Ari Fleischer, May 8, 2001
sources.creator: White House
sources.reading_scope: Selected complete EP-3 and surveillance-flight exchanges, not the whole briefing.
sources.key_locators: Local extraction lines 375–412 and 834–840: return question and possible fighter escorts; resumed surveillance question.
sources.interpretation_limits: States American preference and continuing talks, conditional on airworthiness; does not establish Chinese permission. Declining to discuss military operations is not confirmation of the question’s premise.

sources.title: 唐家璇新书 披露中美撞机事件幕后
sources.creator: Tang Jiaxuan; excerpt published by Hainan Daily
sources.reading_scope: Entire published newspaper excerpt and editorial framing read, not the complete book or chapter.
sources.key_locators: Hainan Daily page 028, 海南周刊·悦读; section “大卸八块”EP-3, first six paragraphs. Book identified as 劲雨煦风, World Affairs Press, November 2009.
sources.interpretation_limits: Tang’s later explanation of the May 10 refusal; no contemporary approval document. Earlier April cables and May 8 statement prevent treating that date as the first refusal. The excerpt’s operational dates were read but are not independently verified here.

sources.title: EP-3: DAI BINGGUO AND THE AMBASSADOR DISCUSS RELATIONS
sources.creator: US Embassy Beijing
sources.reading_scope: Complete nine-page cable, all 16 paragraphs, headings and signoff read. Physical page 3 visually inspected.
sources.key_locators: 2001BEIJING03999; event April 26. Paragraph 4, physical p.3: personal capacity and not a player; paragraphs 1 and 16, physical pp.1–2 and 9: embassy inference about Jiang and hoped transmission.
sources.interpretation_limits: Reported Chinese speech, not a Chinese instruction. Embassy assessment of access to Jiang is distinguished from Dai’s stated personal capacity. No aircraft-removal terms or flyout permission.
sources.release_status: Released in full; State FOIA case F-2010-07070; release-review stamp April 21, 2015; historical classification markings reproduced in a publicly released UNCLASSIFIED facsimile.

sources.title: VPM QIAN QICHEN ON EP-3 AND BILATERAL RELATIONS
sources.creator: US Embassy Beijing
sources.reading_scope: Complete five-page cable, all 11 paragraphs, headings and signoff read. Physical page 2 visually inspected.
sources.key_locators: 2001BEIJING04087; paragraphs 3–4, physical p.2: April 28 farewell dinner, speedy return and assessment-team hopes. Paragraph 5, physical pp.2–3: Qian’s retrospective explanation of leadership notification and phone contacts.
sources.interpretation_limits: Qian’s expectation of return is not flyout permission. Paragraph 4 editorial note calls April 30 the next day, inconsistent with the meeting’s April 28 date in paragraphs 1 and 3; preserve the discrepancy. Embassy interpretation of motives and communications is not established internal history.
sources.release_status: Released in full; State FOIA case F-2010-07070; release-review stamp April 21, 2015; historical classification markings reproduced in a publicly released UNCLASSIFIED facsimile.

sources.title: Secretary of State Powell’s Interview on CNN
sources.creator: Colin Powell, interviewed by Andrea Koppel; US State Department transcript reproduced by USINFO
sources.source_type: Contemporary official interview transcript on nongovernmental historical mirror
sources.reading_scope: Both complete aircraft-return exchanges and adjacent Taiwan/Cabinet-relations exchanges read; whole interview not counted as read. Also checked corresponding CNN original transcript at lines 146–174.
sources.key_locators: Questions beginning “Are we going to get the plane back?” and “On China, with the spy plane”; Powell’s answers about ongoing negotiations.
sources.interpretation_limits: Koppel’s account of Chinese officials’ position is a reporter’s premise. Powell forecasts resolution, supplies no agreed return method and does not authenticate a prior flyout offer.

sources.title: 孙玉玺：中美就拆运EP-3达成协议，撞机事件基本解决
sources.creator: China Daily website; credited 小凤、杜莉; reproduced by Sina
sources.source_type: Contemporary reporting of official spokesperson remarks
sources.reading_scope: Complete short article read in valid retrieved HTML and extracted text.
sources.key_locators: Timestamp June 7, 16:12; first four body paragraphs on announced technical arrangements, team travel and undisclosed details; final paragraph summarizes May agreement in principle.
sources.interpretation_limits: A report of Sun Yuxi’s announcement, not the agreement text or a complete briefing transcript. Headline’s “basically solved” must not replace the body’s prospective language. Does not identify signatories or prove execution.

search_and_acquisition_limits.result: All 46 catalogue records’ titles and dates inspected across existing first page and pages 2–3. All dated April 2001; the collection cannot itself fill the May gap. Two additional relevant April originals acquired and fully read here.

Initial incomplete request failed; request with wrong date format produced irrelevant results. Corrected YYYYMMDD date query returned 153 results, but keyword filtering was not reliable and only the first returned page was inspected. Adding docFrom=BEIJING returned one June 25 cable, C05336047, on Kelly and Chinese AFM; catalogue only, underlying text not acquired. No claim of exhaustive archive search or zero May records.

search_and_acquisition_limits.result: No signed agreement, verbatim negotiated technical protocol, dated Chinese flyout authorization or later US revocation instruction acquired. Public announcements and estimates are not substitutes.

CCTV index yields later operational reports, not the missing agreement. CNN May 8 segment is a partial briefing broadcast and does not preserve Rumsfeld’s aircraft answer; not used as that answer.
